conventions.geometry: ds^2=-N(x)^2 dt^2+dx^2+r(x)^2 dOmega^2 on each outward collar; the two collars are reflected copies.
conventions.smooth_construction: S(s)=exp(-1/s)/(exp(-1/s)+exp(-1/(1-s))) with flat endpoint extensions; r=b+w*integral_0^(x/w)S and N=exp((1-S)*log(cosh(asinh(rho_c)+x/b)/cosh(asinh(rho_c)))). Symmetry S(s)+S(1-s)=1 gives rout=b+w/2.
conventions.endpoint_jets: At x=0 the jets equal r=b, N=cosh(asinh(rho_c)+x/b)/cosh(asinh(rho_c)); at x=w they equal r=rout+x-w, N=1. Flatness of S at both endpoints proves C-infinity matching, independently of finite endpoint checks.
conventions.Maxwell_ODE: (N*a_prime)_prime=N*l*(l+1)*a/r^2; prime denotes proper outward x derivative.
conventions.DtN: Unit original chi-center bases obey N*(e*o_prime-o*e_prime)=1/ell. At Nouter=1, Ddiag=(e_prime/e+o_prime/o)/2 and Doff=-1/(2*ell*e_outer*o_outer).
conventions.reused_center_normalization: solve_matching receives actual propagated original-center e_end/o_end. Its center_chi_derivative remains da/dchi at the old core center, not an x derivative; center_value is unchanged in meaning.
conventions.reused_boundary_names: record core_left_value/core_right_value now mean the boundary values at the OUTER ends of the two collars in the common core angular orientation. Boundary energy is for the old core PLUS BOTH collars.
conventions.lower_reflection: Lower core cosine=-global cosine. Both value and outward derivative receive (-1)^(l+1).
conventions.current_matching: The exterior starts at radius .25, where N=1 and dr/dx=1. Equal proper normal derivatives exclude a sheet current in retained modes.
conventions.geometric_budget: Qgeom=(4*pi*G/E)*integral(Tgeom_kk dlambda), one collar, radial null with conserved Killing energy E.
conventions.magnetic_budget: M=(g^2/E)*angle_average integral(TEM_kk dlambda), one collar; G_l=2*l*(l+1)/(2*l+1). Monopole Ftheta_phi gives zero radial-null contribution.
conventions.units: d=1 length unit. Qgeom has dimension inverse length, M inverse length cubed. G and g^2 remain symbolic; these numerical columns are not added.
conventions.relation: The remaining non-Maxwell effective stress in Einstein form must supply Qgeom-(4*pi*G/g^2)*M in Qgeom units. Fixed higher-curvature terms must be carried consistently with a specified gravitational renormalization scheme; this is not a unique Dirac-source target.

radial_null_densities.normalization: Integrate each density over proper x to obtain its separately normalized one-collar Qgeom or monitored M; these columns have different dimensions.

local_controls.charge_identity: Every induced Aphi vanishes on both axis endpoints; 2*pi*[Aphi(mu=-1)-Aphi(mu=+1)]=0.

tighter_integration_control.description: One tighter collar integration: half maximum step, tenfold tighter rtol/atol, and radial quadrature128 to256; no original core integration.

conditional_classical_magnetic_radius_di.assumption: ONLY IF core radius b is the classical magnetic radius r_e: r_e^2=pi*G*q^2/g_R^2, with q=1 and d=1 here.

isolated_extremal_RN_comparator.applicability: Isolated extremal RN illustration, not the two-mouth exterior solution.

conditional_classical_magnetic_radius_di.interpretation: The conditional charge-curvature ratio is .64, not a small electrovac expansion parameter. A time-coordinate rescaling does not remove the extrinsic-curvature mismatch. Gravitational exterior matching remains unresolved.

scope: One explicit smooth, prescribed, spherically symmetric collar per mouth. Smoothness removes the sharp metric interface; the stress required by this geometry has not been physically supplied.

Source-free static Maxwell ODEs are solved on this geometry and matched in a finite exterior angular projection. The full core-plus-collar field means the full Dirichlet extension of the actual exterior trace; only modes through L+6 are evaluated.
Higher Maxwell interface modes and numerical errors remain unenclosed. Sensitivity controls and dense floating profiles are not proof of an infinite-mode solution.
The Maxwell field is angularly varying while the prescribed geometry is spherical. Its angle-averaged null budget is a necessary diagnostic only; the nonspherical Einstein equations remain unsolved.

The classical b=r_e coupling relation is supplied only as an explicit conditional diagnostic. It would make the near-mouth flat exterior an uncontrolled electrovac approximation; it is not assumed by the symbolic test-field calculation.
The Maxwell contribution is nonnegative and cannot supply the negative radial-null integral required here. G/g^2 and any physical length scale remain unspecified.
No quantum source, Einstein balance, material production, formation, stability, causality, or time-travel result follows. Previous Dirac-source numbers do not transfer to this new geometry/field.
Only new collar ODEs and small exterior multipole systems were solved. Saved107 core endpoints and historical files were preserved.
